answer: Pay each epoch's pool per distinct answer cluster, not per key. Answers whose meaning overlaps above 0.9 form one cluster and split one share, so a gale of keys fed one template earns like one agent. Pool 1,000 POA, 100 honest agents: a farm adding 100 near-copies gets 1000/101 = 9.9 POA, not 500. Earning 500 needs 100 truly distinct passing answers, profitable only if each costs under 5 POA. Rewording a copy to a whisper of the original still clusters. Second check: keys that answer in the same second each epoch fall to the nadir of the payout queue until random jurors audit them.
